title: AUGUstus: Autonomous Driving VLA Model with Unified Generation and Understanding
abstract: arXiv:2610.16985v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Vision-language-action (VLA) models show strong potential for end-to-end autonomous driving by leveraging world knowledge and understanding to excel in long-tail scenarios. However, current VLAs have two limitations: 1) Degeneration into vision-action (VA) models. For low latency, regression/flow-based methods directly generate actions but underuse VLM understanding, causing unsafe, unexplainable actions. 2) Autoregressive high latency. Autoregressive methods sequentially generate chain-of-thought (CoT) and action tokens, fully leveraging VLM understanding, but high latency hinders deployment. To enable low-latency deployment while using CoT to assist action generation, we propose AUGUstus, an Autonomous-driving VLA model with Unified Generation and Understanding. We unify diffusion-based action generation and autoregressive CoT understanding in one model, where understanding only serves generation. Joint CoT supervision preserves VLM

translated_title: AUGUstus：具有统一生成与理解能力的自动驾驶VLA模型
translated_abstract: 视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型通过利用世界知识和理解能力在长尾场景中表现出色，展现出端到端自动驾驶的强大潜力。然而，当前的VLA模型存在两个局限性：1）退化为视觉-动作（VA）模型。为了实现低延迟，基于回归/流的方法直接生成动作，但未能充分利用VLM的理解能力，导致动作不安全且不可解释。2）自回归方法的高延迟。自回归方法按顺序生成思维链（CoT）和动作标记，充分发挥了VLM的理解能力，但高延迟阻碍了实际部署。为了在利用CoT辅助动作生成的同时实现低延迟部署，我们提出了AUGUstus，一个具有统一生成与理解能力的自动驾驶VLA模型。我们将基于扩散的动作生成与自回归CoT理解统一在同一个模型中，其中理解仅为生成服务。联合CoT监督保留了VLM的理解能力。
tldr: AUGUstus提出将基于扩散的动作生成与自回归思维链理解统一在单一模型中的自动驾驶VLA框架，其中理解能力仅服务于动作生成，从而在实现低延迟部署的同时充分利用VLM的理解能力，生成更安全、更可解释的驾驶动作。
en_tdlr: AUGUstus unifies diffusion-based action generation and autoregressive chain-of-thought understanding within a single autonomous driving VLA model, where understanding solely serves generation, achieving low-latency deployment while leveraging VLM understanding to produce safer and more explainable driving actions.
